Key_Metric_Per_Step: Visitor→Signup: conversion rate|Signup→Activate: activation rate|Activate→D7: retention|D7→Refer: viral coefficient|Refer→Pay: monetization
Fix_If_Broken: Low Visit→Sign: messaging/positioning problem → rewrite landing page|Low Sign→Act: onboarding friction → reduce to 3 steps|Low D7: core loop weak → interview churned users
Giantiny_Note: Fix the worst step first — don't optimize top of funnel with leaky bucket

Steps: Visit → Signup → Setup → First Core Action → Aha Moment
Healthy_Range: Setup: >70% complete in <5min|First Action: >50% same session|Aha: >30% within 24h
Fix_If_Broken: Low Setup: too many fields → reduce to email-only|Low First Action: unclear next step → add guided tour|Low Aha: value unclear → show outcome preview before asking input
Giantiny_Note: Aha moment must happen in <60 seconds for dev tools (Pieter Levels)

Steps: Visit → Select Template → Run Simulation → View Results → Return
Key_Metric_Per_Step: Select: >60%|Run: >40% of visitors|Results: >90% of runs|Return: >15% D7
Fix_If_Broken: Low Select: templates not compelling → test different presets|Low Run: too complex → add 1-click 'Quick Sim'|Low Return: no reason to come back → add save/compare feature
Giantiny_Note: This is YOUR funnel. Build it into PostHog Week 1.

Key_Metric_Per_Step: % of cohort still active at each interval
Fix_If_Broken: Steep drop D1→D7: first session not compelling → improve onboarding|Flat after D7: good retention! Focus on acquisition|Steady decline: no habit loop → add notifications/triggers
Giantiny_Note: Retention curve that flattens = PMF. Curve that hits 0 = pivot.

Steps: Free User → Feature Wall Hit → Pricing Page View → Trial Start → Trial Complete → Paid
Key_Metric_Per_Step: Free→Wall: usage depth|Wall→Price: upgrade intent|Price→Trial: pricing acceptance|Trial→Paid: value confirmation
Fix_If_Broken: Low Price→Trial: price too high or value unclear → test lower entry tier|Low Trial→Paid: trial too short or features gated wrong → extend trial or change gate
Giantiny_Note: Don't monetize before PMF. Revenue funnel only after Sean Ellis ≥40%.

Steps: User Gets Value → User Shares → Friend Visits → Friend Signs Up → Friend Gets Value → Friend Shares
Key_Metric_Per_Step: Share rate|Visit rate|Signup rate|Activation rate|Repeat share rate
Fix_If_Broken: Low share rate: product not remarkable → what makes users say 'wow'?|Low visit rate: shared content not compelling → improve referral landing page
Giantiny_Note: Viral coefficient >1 = exponential growth. <0.5 = need paid acquisition.

Steps: Signup → Welcome Screen → First Integration → Import Data → First Insight → Team Invite
Fix_If_Broken: Low Integration: too many options → offer top 3 integrations only|Low Import: data format friction → add CSV/manual option|Low Insight: time-to-value too long → show sample data first
Giantiny_Note: If onboarding >5 steps → you will lose 50%+ users (Giantiny ③)
